title: Sales By Customer Sales Type filter looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "sbc-01-n5-sbc.png" (board 5.1) and "sbc-02-n5-sbc-open.png" (board 5.2) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the closed filter with the picture of board 5.1.
  2. Open it and compare with the picture of board 5.2.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it reads "Sales Type: All Sales" where "Product Type" used to be, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: options "Part Sales" and "Service Sales", both ticked, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R6: “On Sales By Customer, the filter labeled "Product Type" today is labeled "Sales Type".”
  • S8-R7: “Its two options read "Part Sales" and "Service Sales".”
  • S8-R8: “With both options selected, the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales". With one, it reads that option's name, for example "Sales Type: Part Sales". With none, it reads "Sales Type: No sales".”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (19 Oct 2026), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 28: “28. (a) Yes: renamed to "Part Sales" and "Service Sales", and a saved choice keeps its options under the new names.”
